entries.en: The crudity of the carving suggested an inexperienced hand.
entries.zh: 雕刻的粗糙表明制作者经验不足。

entries.en: They left the smoky city for more salubrious surroundings.
entries.zh: 他们离开烟雾弥漫的城市，搬到了更有益健康的环境。

entries.en: A bell rang offstage while the actor opened the letter.
entries.zh: 演员拆信时，舞台外响起了铃声。

entries.en: The exhibition displayed a pair of iron manacles.
entries.zh: 展览陈列了一副铁手铐。

entries.en: The somnolent passengers barely noticed the next stop.
entries.zh: 昏昏欲睡的乘客几乎没注意到下一站。

entries.en: The diagram shows dross floating on the molten metal.
entries.zh: 图中显示浮渣漂在熔融金属上。

entries.en: The scheme continued with the connivance of senior managers.
entries.zh: 这个骗局在高层经理的纵容下继续着。

entries.en: She ignored his gibe about her old bicycle.
entries.zh: 她没有理会他对她旧自行车的嘲讽。

entries.en: The reviewer found the adaptation more prudish than the original novel.
entries.zh: 评论者认为改编作品比原小说更拘谨。

entries.en: The factory pasteurizes the milk before bottling it.
entries.zh: 工厂在装瓶前对牛奶进行巴氏消毒。

entries.en: The navigator's sextant rested in a padded wooden case.
entries.zh: 航海员的六分仪放在有衬垫的木盒里。

entries.en: The impecunious student furnished his room with discarded chairs.
entries.zh: 贫穷的学生用别人丢弃的椅子布置房间。

entries.en: The comedian's entrance prompted uproarious laughter.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员的登场引发了一阵喧闹的大笑。

entries.en: Nobody could gainsay the importance of her discovery.
entries.zh: 没有人能否认她的发现的重要性。

entries.en: The warehouse remained closed while specialists fumigated it.
entries.zh: 专家进行熏蒸消毒时，仓库保持关闭。

entries.en: The diagram labels the anode on the left side of the cell.
entries.zh: 图中将电池左侧标为阳极。

entries.en: The speech recycled shopworn phrases about a brighter future.
entries.zh: 演讲重复着关于美好未来的陈词滥调。

entries.en: Our taciturn companion spoke only when the train stopped.
entries.zh: 我们沉默寡言的同伴只在火车停下时说了话。

entries.en: A look of quiet reproof silenced the whispering students.
entries.zh: 一个无声责备的眼神让窃窃私语的学生安静下来。

entries.en: The story's misanthrope avoids visitors but welcomes stray cats.
entries.zh: 故事中厌恶人类的那个人躲避访客，却欢迎流浪猫。

entries.en: The report described the theater's parlous financial position.
entries.zh: 报告描述了剧院岌岌可危的财务状况。

entries.en: The archive documents three changes in the hotel's proprietorship.
entries.zh: 档案记录了酒店所有权的三次变更。

entries.en: The novel condemns an iniquitous system that rewards dishonesty.
entries.zh: 小说谴责了一个奖励不诚实行为的极不公正的制度。

entries.en: Her espousal of the cause attracted unexpected criticism.
entries.zh: 她对这一事业的拥护招来了意想不到的批评。

entries.en: The biology exhibit includes a model of a tapeworm.
entries.zh: 生物展览中有一个绦虫模型。

entries.en: The station will rebroadcast the interview on Sunday evening.
entries.zh: 电台将于星期日晚上重播这次访谈。

entries.en: A drizzly morning kept most visitors inside the museum.
entries.zh: 一个下毛毛雨的早晨让大多数游客留在博物馆里。

entries.en: The king's toadies applauded every remark he made.
entries.zh: 国王的谄媚者们为他说的每一句话鼓掌。

entries.en: The school archive traces the gradual introduction of coeducation.
entries.zh: 学校档案追溯了逐步实行男女同校的过程。

entries.en: Years of rowing had left a callus on each palm.
entries.zh: 多年的划船使他两只手掌上各长了一块老茧。

entries.en: Inclement weather forced the outdoor concert into the hall.
entries.zh: 恶劣天气迫使露天音乐会移到大厅里。

entries.en: The lecturer's soporific delivery made concentration difficult.
entries.zh: 讲师催人入睡的讲课方式让人难以集中注意力。

entries.en: We finally collected the keys after the usual administrative rigmarole.
entries.zh: 经过惯常的繁琐行政手续后，我们终于领到了钥匙。

entries.en: The relentless heat enervated even the most energetic hikers.
entries.zh: 持续的炎热使最有活力的徒步者也感到疲惫无力。

entries.en: Several members tried to blackball the outspoken applicant.
entries.zh: 几名成员试图投票拒绝接纳那位直言不讳的申请者。

entries.en: She was loth to leave the garden unfinished.
entries.zh: 她不愿在花园尚未整理好时离开。

entries.en: His insouciant shrug irritated the anxious organizers.
entries.zh: 他漫不经心地耸肩，激怒了焦虑的组织者们。

entries.en: The documentary examines the appeal of numerology without endorsing its claims.
entries.zh: 纪录片探讨了数字命理学的吸引力，但并未认可其说法。

entries.en: It was impolitic to criticize the host's collection during dinner.
entries.zh: 在晚餐时批评主人的收藏是不明智的。

entries.en: The exercise asks for a derangement in which no item keeps its original position.
entries.zh: 练习要求作出一个没有任何元素留在原位的错位排列。

entries.en: The rebels retreated to a mountain fastness.
entries.zh: 叛军退到了山中的要塞。

entries.en: Years of neglect had reduced the manor to dilapidation.
entries.zh: 多年的疏于维护使庄园破败不堪。

entries.en: He cast a covetous glance at his neighbor's new telescope.
entries.zh: 他贪求地瞥了一眼邻居的新望远镜。

entries.meaningZh: 爬行动物与两栖动物学家
entries.en: The herpetologist photographed a tiny frog beside the stream.
entries.zh: 爬行动物与两栖动物学家在溪边拍下了一只小青蛙。

entries.en: An ellipsis at the end suggests an unfinished thought.
entries.zh: 末尾的省略号暗示了一个未说完的想法。

entries.en: The sudden silence betokened more than simple surprise.
entries.zh: 突然的沉默表明的不只是惊讶。

entries.en: The astronomy class compared sidereal time with solar time.
entries.zh: 天文学课比较了恒星时与太阳时。

entries.en: The villain's detestable behavior makes the ending satisfying.
entries.zh: 反派可憎的行为使结局令人满意。

entries.en: The editorial rejected the jingoism surrounding the border dispute.
entries.zh: 社论反对围绕边界争端滋生的沙文主义。

entries.en: The historian studied plebeian households rather than royal courts.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究的是平民家庭而非王室宫廷。

entries.en: A gangling teenager struggled to fit into the tiny chair.
entries.zh: 一个瘦长笨拙的少年费力地坐进小椅子里。

entries.en: The display separates arachnids from the neighboring insect specimens.
entries.zh: 展柜将蛛形纲动物与旁边的昆虫标本分开展示。

entries.en: The egotist turned every conversation back to his achievements.
entries.zh: 那个自我中心的人把每次谈话都转回自己的成就。

entries.en: He glanced perfunctorily at the drawing before changing the subject.
entries.zh: 他敷衍地看了一眼画作，便转移了话题。

entries.en: Her frank avowal of uncertainty surprised the panel.
entries.zh: 她坦率地承认没有把握，让评审团感到意外。

entries.en: A puckish grin suggested that he had hidden the trophy.
entries.zh: 他顽皮的笑容暗示奖杯是他藏起来的。

entries.en: The war bereaved countless families in the region.
entries.zh: 战争使这个地区无数家庭失去了亲人。

entries.en: The council governed during the interregnum between the two monarchs.
entries.zh: 两位君主之间的空位期内，由议会治理。

entries.en: The wearisome argument resumed as soon as dinner ended.
entries.zh: 晚餐一结束，那场令人厌倦的争论便重新开始。

entries.en: A cowhand rode out to check the distant fence.
entries.zh: 一名牧牛工骑马出去查看远处的围栏。

entries.en: Her fervid defense of the painting impressed the audience.
entries.zh: 她对这幅画的热烈辩护给观众留下了深刻印象。

entries.en: Moss filled the interstices between the paving stones.
entries.zh: 苔藓填满了铺路石之间的缝隙。

entries.en: The retiring conductor received a generous encomium from the orchestra.
entries.zh: 退休的指挥获得了乐团热情洋溢的赞辞。

entries.en: The columnist fulminated against the destruction of the wetlands.
entries.zh: 专栏作家严词谴责了破坏湿地的行为。

entries.en: The archive documents changing laws concerning vagrancy.
entries.zh: 档案记录了有关流浪的法律的变化。

entries.en: The investigation exposed the advertisement's mendacious claims.
entries.zh: 调查揭露了广告中的虚假说法。

entries.en: The philosopher sought a univocal definition acceptable to both sides.
entries.zh: 哲学家寻求一个双方都能接受、意义单一明确的定义。

entries.en: Her reportorial skills gave the biography unusual immediacy.
entries.zh: 她的新闻报道技巧赋予这部传记非同寻常的现场感。

entries.en: The play traces the ruler's descent into megalomania.
entries.zh: 这部戏描绘了统治者逐渐陷入狂妄自大的过程。

entries.en: She refused to let the anonymous calumny end her career.
entries.zh: 她拒绝让匿名诽谤终结自己的事业。

entries.en: Her equable temperament steadied the nervous crew.
entries.zh: 她平和稳定的性情使紧张的船员们镇定下来。

entries.en: Salt and wind had roughened the painted surface.
entries.zh: 盐和风使涂漆表面变得粗糙。

entries.en: He misperceived her silence as approval.
entries.zh: 他把她的沉默误解为赞同。

entries.en: The archaeological team mapped a necropolis beyond the city walls.
entries.zh: 考古队绘制了城墙外一处大型古墓地的地图。

entries.en: The rival captains agreed to a parley at dawn.
entries.zh: 对立双方的队长同意在黎明时谈判。

entries.en: The crew kept the cramped cabin shipshape.
entries.zh: 船员们把狭小的船舱收拾得整洁有序。

entries.en: A sibilant whisper came from behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 帘子后传来嘶嘶般的低语。

entries.en: The sonar image revealed a previously unmapped seamount.
entries.zh: 声呐图像显示了一座此前未被绘入地图的海山。

entries.en: The hikers reconnoitered the campsite before carrying over their bags.
entries.zh: 徒步者们先勘察了营地，再把包搬过去。

entries.en: The novel presents his long exile as an act of expiation.
entries.zh: 小说将他漫长的流亡表现为一种赎罪行为。

entries.en: The friable rock crumbled under the geologist's fingers.
entries.zh: 易碎的岩石在地质学家指间碎裂。

entries.en: The review discusses sensitization following repeated exposure.
entries.zh: 综述讨论了反复接触后的致敏作用。

entries.en: The verbose explanation obscured a fairly simple idea.
entries.zh: 冗长的解释掩盖了一个相当简单的想法。

entries.en: The guide found fresh spoor near the watering hole.
entries.zh: 向导在水坑附近发现了新鲜的动物踪迹。

entries.en: The villain muttered an imprecation as the door closed.
entries.zh: 门关上时，反派低声说了一句诅咒。

entries.en: Years of neglect had enfeebled the once vigorous institution.
entries.zh: 多年的疏于管理使这个曾经充满活力的机构衰弱了。

entries.en: The moderator removed several vituperative comments from the discussion.
entries.zh: 主持人从讨论中删除了几条辱骂性评论。

entries.en: The school district is coterminous with the town.
entries.zh: 该学区与这个镇的边界重合。

entries.en: Her hauteur vanished when the child offered her a flower.
entries.zh: 孩子递给她一朵花时，她的傲慢消失了。

entries.en: The machine emulsifies the mixture into a smooth cream.
entries.zh: 机器将混合物乳化成细滑的膏体。

entries.en: Serried ranks of folding chairs filled the hall.
entries.zh: 一排排密集的折叠椅摆满了大厅。

entries.en: The manager tried to conciliate the disappointed visitors.
entries.zh: 经理试图安抚失望的访客。

entries.en: The surgical record notes that a small vessel was cauterized.
entries.zh: 手术记录记载了一条小血管接受了烧灼处理。

entries.en: The desert shimmer offered illusive pools of water.
entries.zh: 沙漠中闪烁的景象显现出虚幻的水池。

entries.en: The satire attacks careerism within the cultural establishment.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品抨击了文化机构中的名利追逐。

entries.en: She ended the essay with a memorable epigram.
entries.zh: 她用一句令人难忘的警句结束了文章。

entries.en: Without the missing letters, any account remains conjectural.
entries.zh: 缺少那些信件，任何叙述都仍是推测。

entries.en: The crotchety caretaker grumbled as he unlocked the gate.
entries.zh: 脾气乖戾的管理员一边开门一边嘟囔。

entries.en: The critic dismissed the thriller as a predictable potboiler.
entries.zh: 评论家认为这部惊悚作品不过是情节俗套的粗制滥造商业作品。

entries.en: The fruitfulness of their collaboration became evident in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 他们合作的丰硕成果在展览中显现出来。

entries.en: She left a remunerative position to pursue pottery.
entries.zh: 她离开了报酬丰厚的职位，转而从事陶艺。

entries.en: The exhibition paired visual artworks with gustatory experiences.
entries.zh: 展览将视觉艺术作品与味觉体验结合起来。

entries.en: The snobbish character wrongly assumes that every farmer is a yokel.
entries.zh: 这个势利的人物错误地认为每个农民都是乡巴佬。

entries.en: The mineral had a bright vitreous luster.
entries.zh: 这种矿物有明亮的玻璃光泽。

entries.en: Her extemporaneous remarks were warmer than the prepared speech.
entries.zh: 她即席的发言比事先准备的演讲更亲切。

entries.en: The publisher withdrew the libelous passage before printing.
entries.zh: 出版商在印刷前撤下了那段诽谤性文字。

entries.en: The festival celebrates the region's gastronomy and agricultural traditions.
entries.zh: 节日庆祝该地区的美食文化和农业传统。

entries.en: The genealogical chart identifies the poet's lineal descendants.
entries.zh: 族谱标出了诗人的直系后代。

entries.en: The venturesome traveler chose the less familiar route.
entries.zh: 敢于冒险的旅行者选择了那条不太熟悉的路线。

entries.en: The braggart claimed to have climbed every mountain in sight.
entries.zh: 那个吹牛者声称爬过视野里的每一座山。

entries.en: The technician measured the workpiece before releasing the clamp.
entries.zh: 技术员在松开夹具前测量了工件。

entries.en: The priest condemned the fictional king's impious boasts.
entries.zh: 神父谴责了故事中国王不敬神的夸口。

entries.en: A sepulchral voice echoed from the empty corridor.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的走廊里回荡着阴森低沉的声音。

entries.en: The committee tried to arrogate powers reserved for the full council.
entries.zh: 委员会试图僭取属于全体理事会的权力。

entries.en: The workshop still relied on a superannuated filing system.
entries.zh: 作坊仍依赖一套过时的归档系统。

entries.en: The study compared the hedonic value of different musical passages.
entries.zh: 研究比较了不同音乐片段带来的愉悦价值。

entries.en: The retired pugilist displayed his old gloves above the fireplace.
entries.zh: 退役拳击手把旧拳套陈列在壁炉上方。

entries.en: The clear morning seemed a good augury for the voyage.
entries.zh: 晴朗的早晨似乎是航行的好兆头。

entries.en: The cartoon shows a plutocrat towering over a miniature parliament.
entries.zh: 漫画中，一位财阀高踞于微型议会之上。

entries.en: She looked a little peaky after the overnight journey.
entries.zh: 通宵赶路后，她显得有些苍白憔悴。

entries.en: The fictional machine magnifies every sound a thousandfold.
entries.zh: 故事中的机器把每个声音都放大一千倍。

entries.en: The cabinet's elephantine proportions overwhelmed the small room.
entries.zh: 柜子笨重的尺寸让小房间显得拥挤不堪。

entries.en: The first chapter adumbrates the argument developed later.
entries.zh: 第一章勾勒了后文将展开的论点。

entries.en: Rain left his lank hair plastered against his forehead.
entries.zh: 雨水使他软塌的长发贴在额头上。

entries.en: She preferred durable furniture to faddish designs.
entries.zh: 相比追逐潮流的设计，她更喜欢耐用的家具。

entries.en: The novel's aging libertine regrets the friendships he squandered.
entries.zh: 小说中年老的放荡者后悔自己糟蹋了那些友谊。

entries.en: The sketches reveal her extraordinary draftsmanship.
entries.zh: 这些素描显示了她非凡的绘图技艺。

entries.en: A cloudburst sent us running into the station.
entries.zh: 一场突如其来的暴雨使我们跑进了车站。

entries.en: The review describes a sybaritic world of private gardens and elaborate banquets.
entries.zh: 评论描述了一个拥有私人花园与奢华宴席的享乐世界。

entries.en: The critic's dyspeptic review found fault with every scene.
entries.zh: 这位评论家乖戾的评论对每一场戏都挑毛病。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram traces the alimentary canal.
entries.zh: 解剖图展示了消化道的走向。

entries.en: The fable contrasts a slothful prince with a diligent gardener.
entries.zh: 寓言将懒惰的王子与勤劳的园丁作了对比。

entries.en: Her conduct throughout the difficult meeting was unexceptionable.
entries.zh: 在整场艰难的会议中，她的举止无可非议。

entries.en: The exhibition celebrates a polymath who painted, composed, and studied astronomy.
entries.zh: 展览纪念了一位兼擅绘画、作曲和天文学的博学者。

entries.en: He incurred public odium by betraying his closest supporters.
entries.zh: 他背叛最亲近的支持者，招致了公众的憎恶。

entries.en: A faulty connection garbled the final part of her message.
entries.zh: 连接故障使她消息的最后一部分混乱难懂。

entries.en: Weather was only one of the expedition's many imponderables.
entries.zh: 天气只是这次远征众多难以估量的因素之一。

entries.en: He answered with circumlocution instead of a clear refusal.
entries.zh: 他用迂回的说法回答，而没有明确拒绝。

entries.en: They inveigled the reluctant actor into joining the amateur production.
entries.zh: 他们哄得那位不情愿的演员参加了业余演出。

entries.en: He had the effrontery to complain about the gift.
entries.zh: 他竟厚颜无耻地抱怨这份礼物。

entries.en: The collection preserves several obsolescent recording formats.
entries.zh: 这批藏品保存了几种逐渐过时的录音格式。

entries.en: The watchmaker discovered a broken mainspring inside the clock.
entries.zh: 钟表匠发现钟内的主发条断了。

entries.en: The photograph captures the incandescence of the heated metal.
entries.zh: 照片捕捉到了受热金属的白炽状态。

entries.en: The comedy presents its hero as an irredeemable optimist.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧把主人公描绘成一个无可救药的乐观主义者。

entries.en: An engraved astrolabe occupied the center of the display.
entries.zh: 一只雕刻精美的星盘位于展柜中央。

entries.en: The sauce's saltiness overwhelmed the delicate vegetables.
entries.zh: 酱汁的咸味盖过了蔬菜的清淡味道。

entries.en: The model revealed the impracticality of the proposed roof.
entries.zh: 模型揭示了所提屋顶设计的不切实际。

entries.en: The diary describes a period of debility after the illness.
entries.zh: 日记描述了病后的一段虚弱时期。

entries.en: The memoir depicts a once formidable ruler in his dotage.
entries.zh: 回忆录描绘了一位曾令人敬畏的统治者衰老糊涂的晚年。

entries.en: The workshop demonstrated subtractive color mixing with transparent inks.
entries.zh: 工作坊用透明油墨演示了减色混合。

entries.en: The damaged seal allowed water ingress during the storm.
entries.zh: 损坏的密封件使水在暴风雨中渗入。

entries.en: An unbidden memory interrupted her concentration.
entries.zh: 一段不由自主浮现的记忆打断了她的注意力。

entries.en: Lambs gambolled around the edge of the meadow.
entries.zh: 小羊在草地边缘嬉戏跳跃。

entries.en: Elocution lessons helped the actor project his voice.
entries.zh: 演说技巧课帮助演员提高了声音的穿透力。

entries.en: A trainload of timber arrived at the mill.
entries.zh: 一整列火车的木材运到了锯木厂。

entries.en: The demonstration showed how expansion rarefies a gas.
entries.zh: 演示展示了膨胀如何使气体变稀薄。

entries.en: The editorial accused the fictional minister of being a warmonger.
entries.zh: 社论指责那位虚构的部长是战争贩子。

entries.en: The idea gestated for years before becoming a novel.
entries.zh: 这个想法酝酿多年后才变成一部小说。

entries.en: Someone had purloined the silver spoon from the display.
entries.zh: 有人从展柜里偷走了那把银匙。

entries.en: The balloonist waved as the basket rose above the field.
entries.zh: 吊篮升至田野上空时，热气球驾驶员挥了挥手。

entries.en: The visiting team drubbed the champions by six goals.
entries.zh: 客队以六球优势大败冠军队。

entries.en: Her interrogative tone suggested that she doubted the story.
entries.zh: 她的疑问语气表明她怀疑这个说法。

entries.en: Sere leaves rustled along the deserted path.
entries.zh: 干枯的叶子沿着荒无人迹的小路沙沙作响。

entries.en: The story's incorporeal narrator passes unnoticed through locked rooms.
entries.zh: 故事中无形体的叙述者穿过锁着的房间而无人察觉。

entries.en: The supposedly easy sinecure proved surprisingly demanding.
entries.zh: 那个据说轻松的闲职竟然要求很高。

entries.en: In the legend, villagers offered gifts to propitiate the mountain spirit.
entries.zh: 传说中，村民献礼以求得山神欢心。

entries.en: The boor interrupted every story to boast about himself.
entries.zh: 那个粗鲁的人打断每一个故事，吹嘘自己。

entries.en: A stentorian announcement silenced the noisy platform.
entries.zh: 一声洪亮的广播让嘈杂的站台安静下来。

entries.en: The artist scissored long strips from a sheet of red paper.
entries.zh: 艺术家从一张红纸上剪下长纸条。

entries.en: A dabbler in photography, he rarely developed his own film.
entries.zh: 作为摄影方面浅尝辄止的爱好者，他很少自己冲洗胶卷。

entries.en: The report particularizes the damage to each building.
entries.zh: 报告详细说明了每栋建筑的损坏情况。

entries.en: He tried to cadge a lift from the departing visitors.
entries.zh: 他试着请求即将离开的客人让他搭车。

entries.en: The pedant interrupted the story to correct an irrelevant date.
entries.zh: 那个迂腐的学究打断故事，纠正一个无关紧要的日期。

entries.en: The museum provides touchable replicas beside the fragile originals.
entries.zh: 博物馆在易碎的原件旁提供可触摸的复制品。

entries.en: Sawdust is a byproduct of the workshop's furniture production.
entries.zh: 锯末是作坊制作家具的副产品。

entries.en: The trial compared fertilized plots with unfertilized ones.
entries.zh: 试验比较了施肥地块与未施肥地块。

entries.en: Gentle waves laved the steps beneath the old bridge.
entries.zh: 轻柔的波浪冲洗着旧桥下的台阶。

entries.en: A timorous knock came from the other side of the door.
entries.zh: 门的另一边传来胆怯的敲门声。

entries.en: The scandal exposed a pattern of mendacity among senior officials.
entries.zh: 丑闻揭露了高级官员一贯说谎的行为。

entries.en: His stinginess extended even to replacing a broken light bulb.
entries.zh: 他吝啬得连坏灯泡都舍不得换。

entries.en: The jury considered whether he had premeditated the attack.
entries.zh: 陪审团考虑了他是否预谋了这次袭击。

entries.en: A shipload of oranges reached the harbor that morning.
entries.zh: 那天早晨，一船橙子运抵港口。

entries.en: The ductile metal could be drawn into thin wire.
entries.zh: 这种有延展性的金属可以被拉成细丝。

entries.en: He never obtruded his opinions on an unwilling audience.
entries.zh: 他从不向不愿听的人强行灌输自己的意见。

entries.en: The boutique displayed modish coats in startling colors.
entries.zh: 精品店陈列着颜色惊艳的时髦外套。

entries.en: She expostulated with the driver about his reckless speed.
entries.zh: 她针对司机鲁莽的车速向他提出严正劝告。

entries.en: The play's ingrate abandons the friends who supported him.
entries.zh: 戏中那个忘恩负义的人抛弃了曾支持他的朋友。

entries.en: The exercise asks students to supply an antonym for each adjective.
entries.zh: 练习要求学生为每个形容词写一个反义词。

entries.en: The tired conductor grew testy during the final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 疲惫的指挥在最后一次排练中变得易怒。

entries.en: His harmless jape brought a smile to the solemn gathering.
entries.zh: 他无伤大雅的玩笑让严肃的聚会上出现了笑容。

entries.en: Despite her remonstrance, the committee postponed the exhibition.
entries.zh: 尽管她提出抗议，委员会仍推迟了展览。

entries.en: The university added a field course to its agronomy program.
entries.zh: 大学在农学课程中增加了一门田野实践课。

entries.en: His sister acted as an intercessor between him and their angry father.
entries.zh: 姐姐在他与生气的父亲之间代为说情。

entries.en: The adaptation rejects the stereotype of the elderly landlady as a harridan.
entries.zh: 改编作品拒绝把老年女房东描绘成凶悍老妇人的刻板印象。

entries.en: The memoir refuses to sentimentalize the hardships of village life.
entries.zh: 这部回忆录拒绝将乡村生活的艰辛感伤化。

entries.en: The researchers described the compound as chemically labile.
entries.zh: 研究人员称这种化合物在化学性质上不稳定。

entries.en: There was considerable palaver before we finally chose a restaurant.
entries.zh: 经过一番折腾，我们才终于选定一家餐厅。

entries.en: The persnickety collector noticed a tiny flaw in the frame.
entries.zh: 过分挑剔的收藏家注意到了画框上的一个微小瑕疵。

entries.en: Only a few diehards remained after the team's long losing streak.
entries.zh: 球队长期连败后，只剩下几个铁杆支持者。

entries.en: A seemly silence followed the solemn announcement.
entries.zh: 庄严的宣布之后是一阵得体的沉默。
